title: CollisionShapes keyframe button desynced
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8097) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900HX (32 threads) - 31.62 GiB memory ### Issue description The 'key' icon for keyframing properties is de-synced inside of CollisionShape properties (e.g., Radius in CircleShape2D). Examples: 1. If it's expanded when you click on the animation tab, the inner properties won't get the key-frame button. 2. If it's expanded when you click off the animation tab, the inner properties will continue to be key-framed. 3. In both cases, closing/re-expanding the tab will cause the key-frame button to sync correctly. Here is an image showing the desync (key-frame buttons persisting when they shouldn't). ### Steps to reproduce Open reproduction project, or create a new project with at least: AnimationPlayer with valid animation, and CollisionShape2D node with CircleShape2D as shape. Follow the steps above to generate a desync. In other words, select the CircleShape2D node, expand the circle tab (so that radius is shown), then select the animation tab on the bottom. Desync will occur. You can also desync it in the reverse direction. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [bug_keyframebutton_2026-02-03_10-56-29.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25042022/bug_keyframebutton_2026-02-03_10-56-29.zip)
